why: Carry the G 1e-17, s 1.5152, 1.25 M_Ch giant on from evolve4-20's checkpoint (15.114 Gyr, Teff 3300 K). evolve4-20 stopped there because relax.js stalled: its line search on the max norm refused every step while the photosphere sat 0.3-0.7% off in ln P. Fixed since: the line search is on the sum of squares; a stall or iteration cap under loose= is accepted (shooting's rule); the cool-gas blend is a smoothstep; and the cool gas carries the local composition where the giant's envelope reaches matter the old convective core processed (it sat 0.65x the interior's density there, a physics error). In the sandbox the star then runs on past Tc 190 MK, R 9.6e10 m, Teff 2405 K. Hstop=0 removes that floor so the run follows the hydrogen shell outward. The question is unchanged: does the core reach the 1 M_Ch it needs to explode.
